dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I'm guessing this Lantern Rite is the same as every year.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The demons have retreated and the humans are safe and well. If Pervases knew... it would be a lifelong wish come true for him.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I trust you're not here to invite me to watch the fireworks in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I think I'll be fine right here.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: As long as the fireworks fly high enough, you can see them from wherever you are. Besides, if anyone wishes to see me, I know they'll come and find me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: So whether I'm here or in the city... it makes no difference.
